# HL7 v2 Inpatient Admission Notification

## Message Type and Trigger Event

**Message Type:** ADT (Admission, Discharge, Transfer)

**Trigger Event:** A01 (Admit/Visit Notification)

## Key Details

The **ADT^A01** message is the standard HL7 v2 construct used to notify receiving systems when a patient is admitted to an inpatient facility. This message contains demographic and clinical information about the admission and is typically sent to:

- Electronic health record (EHR) systems
- Billing and registration systems
- Laboratory and radiology information systems
- Nursing and clinical care systems

## Common Related ADT Messages

- **A02** – Transfer (patient moves to different bed/unit)
- **A03** – Discharge/End Visit
- **A04** – Register Patient (outpatient)
- **A05** – Pre-Admit Patient

The ADT message family is one of the most fundamental message types in HL7 v2 healthcare interoperability standards.
